description: This PHP source file defines a view class 'ProjectViewQuickedit' that extends the 'ViewQuickEdit' class to implement custom behavior for a quick edit interface in a SuiteCRM module related to 'Project'. It manages templates and button configurations based on specific record properties, and overrides the preDisplay method to customize the user interface before rendering.

classes.name: ProjectViewQuickedit
classes.description: A class extending ViewQuickEdit, customized for handling quick edit view logic for Project records, including template management and UI configuration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Method that checks the record properties and adjusts templates and buttons before displaying the view, overriding the parent implementation.
